title: How quantum computers will break all encryption by 2030

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know quantum computers could crack your passwords in minutes?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Right now, governments are racing to upgrade security before 2030.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Quantum computers use qubits to solve problems no classical computer can.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Shor’s algorithm can break RSA encryption in seconds, not years.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects banks, military, and your personal data — all at once.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Encryption needs a quantum-safe upgrade — and fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Follow me for the latest on how tech is changing the world.
